dataset: Real CHIME/FRB catalog dispersion delay: FRB 20180916B
source: FRB 20180916B is the first periodically-repeating fast radio burst discovered by CHIME (its ~16.35-day activity cycle was reported by CHIME/FRB Collaboration, 2020, Nature). Its measured fitburst DM = 349.349 pc/cm^3 (CHIME/FRB Collaboration catalog, Amiri et al. 2021) is used with the exact cold-plasma dispersion law to compute the arrival delay at each frequency below, relative to 1600 MHz.
citation: CHIME/FRB Collaboration, Amiri, M. et al., 2021. The First CHIME/FRB Fast Radio Burst Catalog. The Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 257(2), p.59.
catalog_summary: The full CHIME/FRB catalog (535 bursts) spans DM = 103.4 to 3038.1 pc/cm^3 with a median DM of 533.1 pc/cm^3.
requiredCitations: Lorimer, D.R. et al., 2007. A bright millisecond radio burst of extragalactic origin. Science, 318(5851), pp.777-780.
